Thank goodness. I'm almost there is this surrealist chamber musical written and starring Todd Allen, directed by David Cromer. But as our main character is literally just trying to open the door to potential love, he meets all of these obstacles on the way, represented by different characters. You have the sexy beast, you have the vampire, and each of these characters seems really weird and quirky. But it's such a perfect representation for the things that we do to prevent ourselves from, like, being vulnerable and just, you know, opening ourselves up to the things that we deserve in life. And the entire show is this mix of narration of him taking you through this journey, mixed with songs that are, like, some of my favorite melodies that I heard at fringe. It feels like the perfect mix of Jason Robert Brown piano melodies with the recitative lyrics of Dave Malloy. Like, I just, ah. I love this score so much.
